install_pytext_package: install the pytext-nlp package using pip install pytext-nlp for text modeling
run_pytext_cli: run the pytext command line tool to train and evaluate text models
setup_pytext_entry_point: set up the pytext console script entry point pointing to pytext.main:main
configure_pytext_requirements: configure pytext package dependencies by reading requirements.txt during setup
build_pytext_distribution: build a distribution of the pytext-nlp package using setuptools find_packages
